You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Problem:
To make fruit loop rice krispie treats, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a fresh box of Fruit Loops cereal (30 minutes)
Step 2. Grease the baking pan with butter (2 minutes)
Step 3. Measure out the mini marshmallows (3 minutes)
Step 4. Melt the butter in a large pot (5 minutes)
Step 5. Pour the cereal into the marshmallow mixture (2 minutes)
Step 6. Locate the large mixing spatula (1 minute)
Step 7. Clear a space on the kitchen counter (5 minutes)
Step 8. Crush a small portion of cereal for topping (4 minutes)
Step 9. Unpack the bag of puffed rice cereal (1 minute)
Step 10. Check the expiration date on the marshmallows (30 seconds)
Step 11. Set out a cooling rack (1 minute)
Step 12. Retrieve the rice cereal from the pantry (1 minute)
Step 13. Wash the large mixing pot (10 minutes)
Step 14. Organize all necessary baking utensils (5 minutes)
Step 15. Lightly salt the butter while melting (30 seconds)
Step 16. Prepare a sheet of parchment paper (1 minute)
Step 17. Sanitize the prep area (10 minutes)
Step 18. Measure the puffed rice cereal (2 minutes)
Step 19. Open the marshmallow packaging (1 minute)
Step 20. Dry the mixing pot thoroughly (2 minutes)
Step 21. Measure the Fruit Loops cereal (3 minutes)
Step 22. Set aside a small bowl for extra toppings (1 minute)
Step 23. Turn on the stove to low heat (30 seconds)
Step 24. Clean the measuring cups (5 minutes)
Step 25. Soften the butter at room temperature (45 minutes)
Step 26. Drive to the grocery store (15 minutes)
Step 27. Find the kitchen scale (2 minutes)
Step 28. Take the butter out of the refrigerator (1 minute)
Step 29. Discard the empty marshmallow wrapper (30 seconds)
Step 30. Line the pan with parchment paper (2 minutes)
Step 31. Level the cereal in the box (30 seconds)
Step 32. Spray the spatula with non-stick spray (30 seconds)
Step 33. Rinse the mixing bowl (3 minutes)
Step 34. Check the inventory of all ingredients (10 minutes)
Step 35. Combine the different cereal types in a bowl (2 minutes)
Step 36. Let the treats set at room temperature (1 hour)
Step 37. Press the mixture firmly into the pan (5 minutes)
Step 38. Get the decorative sprinkles (1 minute)
Step 39. Mix the cereal colors for aesthetics (5 minutes)
Step 40. Sift out the cereal dust (2 minutes)
Step 41. Sprinkle the crushed cereal over the top (2 minutes)
Step 42. Cut the butter into small cubes (3 minutes)
Step 43. Prepare a knife for slicing (1 minute)
Step 44. Stir the marshmallows until fully melted (8 minutes)
Step 45. Remove the pot from the heat source (30 seconds)
Step 46. Put on oven mitts (30 seconds)
Step 47. Fold the cereal into the melted marshmallow goo (4 minutes)
Step 48. Wipe down the stove top (5 minutes)
Step 49. Open the cereal box (30 seconds)
Step 50. Pour a bowl of cereal for a snack (2 minutes)
